details.label: INCORRECT
details.reasoning: The gold target is 2018, while the predicted answer explicitly identifies 2010 as the year with the highest emissions, so it contradicts the target.
details.groundedness_reasoning:
1. Citation [1] provides CO₂ emissions from agriculture for only selected years, including 2016–2020.
2. In those figures, 2017 is 8.0 and 2018 is 7.3, so the cited values do not support 2018 as the highest year. They also do not provide complete data for every year from 2010 through 2020.
3. No retrieved citation establishes that 2018 had the highest CO₂ emissions from crop cultivation. Therefore, the gold target is ungrounded.
